---
title: "Case study: panel and bloc frames in political paired comparisons"
---

Paired comparisons between political parties, judged by panels during a government crisis, fitted with the comparative-judgement frame model: panels and party blocs carry their own units, and the script compares bootstrap with judge-clustered standard errors on the panel-unit ratio.

The complete script ships with the package and runs from a plain R session:

```r
file.edit(system.file("casestudies", "party_blocs_crisis.R", package = "rasch"))
```

```{r script, echo = TRUE, eval = FALSE, code = readLines(file.path("..", "..", "inst", "casestudies", "party_blocs_crisis.R"))}
```
